title: History

photo.alt: The full orchestra posing in front of a cathedral
photo.caption: Group portrait

paragraphs: From small-town vaquerías to the great stages, the Real Orquesta Yucateca de Arturo Turriza brings the jarana to every party.
Founded in Tizimín in 2018 by Arturo Turriza and young musicians from Tizimín and Espita. Today it plays in more than 50 municipalities of Yucatán, in Quintana Roo and in Campeche.

events.title: ROYAT is born
events.text: Arturo Turriza founds the Real Orquesta Yucateca in Tizimín with young musicians from Tizimín and Espita.

photos.alt: The first four ROYAT musicians with their saxophones and trumpet beside a cenote

events.title: The first vaquería
events.text: The orchestra's first vaquería, at the Sucilá Fair. Our godfather: maestro Eufrasio Pech Santana.

photos.alt: The orchestra playing at night at its first vaquería, at the Sucilá Fair
A young member next to maestro Eufrasio Pech, wearing a hat
photos.caption: With maestro Eufrasio

events.title: From town to town
events.text: Vaquerías in Tinum, Valladolid, Sucilá and the comisarías of Tizimín.

photos.alt: Seven orchestra members in front of an altar with papel picado

events.title: La Alborada de Tizimín
events.text: First time at the Alborada vaquería, with a new look and new members alongside the founders.

photos.alt: The orchestra on the Alborada de Tizimín stage, with their ROYAT music stands
A trumpeter behind the music stand with the orchestra's logo

events.title: Beyond the vaquería
events.text: They reach Mocochá, San Felipe and Baca, and also accompany folk ballets.

photos.alt: The orchestra playing in front of the church of Mocochá, at night
The orchestra on the stage of the Alborada de San Felipe

events.title: Consolidation
events.text: Vaquerías in Panabá, Cenotillo, Conkal, Chemax, Sanahcat, Río Lagartos and Espita, and in Quintana Roo and Campeche. Their arrangers and composers put their jaranas in the public's taste.

photos.alt: Orchestra members standing under pennant banners, in Chemax
The orchestra on a large stage with fireworks

events.title: First singles
events.text: «La Flor del Oriente» and «Linda Elizabeth» arrive on digital platforms.

events.title: ¡A Bailar en Tizimín!
events.text: The single arrives on digital platforms.

events.title: First album
events.text: «¡A Bailar en Tizimín!»: 15 jaranas recorded live at the Tizimín vaquería 2024.

events.title: Jubileo de Oro
events.text: Twelve jaranas from days gone by with timbales legend Manuel Castillo, his son Irbin and Joss Novelo, of the Trovadoras del Mayab.

events.title: La Fiesta de Yucatán
events.text: Twenty tracks with Felipe de la Cruz, Joss Novelo and Julio Ortiz. It was presented with a vaquería at the Gran Museo del Mundo Maya, one of the largest in Mérida.

photos.alt: The orchestra and jarana dancers posing in front of the Gran Museo del Mundo Maya

events.title: Palacio de la Música
events.text: The orchestra's first performance at the Palacio de la Música in Mérida.

photos.alt: Jarana dancers fill the Palacio de la Música while the orchestra plays in the back, under papel picado pennants
A singer with a microphone in front of the orchestra and its ROYAT music stands at the Palacio de la Música

events.title: Hidalgo and Oaxaca
events.text: ROYAT travels accompanying the Ensamble Folklórico de Quintana Roo.

photos.alt: Poster of the Ensamble Folklórico Peninsular, Hidalgo–Oaxaca, with the Ensamble Folklórico de Quintana Roo and ROYAT: July 24 and 25, 6:00 p.m., Galera Municipal de Atlapexco, Hidalgo. Three dancers with rebozos and Oaxacan costumes

events.title: Parque Xcaret
events.text: At the Festival de Tradiciones de Vida y Muerte at Parque Xcaret.

photos.alt: Invitation from the Ensamble Folklórico de Quintana Roo to ROYAT for the 20th edition of the Festival de Tradiciones de Vida y Muerte 2026, at Parque Xcaret: October 29, 30 and 31 and November 1, 2 and 3, 2026
